the-cop-who-wasnt.title: I heard someone picking the lock of the motel room next to mine
the-cop-who-wasnt.description: I was two doors down from a man working the locks of motel rooms with a piece of wire. I dragged a dresser against my door and climbed out the bathroom window to the office. They found him in another room the next week. #truehorror #reallifehorror #ScaryTales

the-open-motel-door.title: I heard someone picking the lock of the motel room next to mine
the-open-motel-door.description: I was two doors down from a man working the locks of motel rooms with a piece of wire. I dragged a dresser against my door and climbed out the bathroom window to the office. They found him in another room the next week. #truehorror #reallifehorror #ScaryTales

the-refrigerator-truck.title: My manager locked me inside a refrigerated trailer and walked away
the-refrigerator-truck.description: I was unloading a refrigerated trailer when the doors slammed shut behind me and the locking bar was thrown home. I watched my manager walk away with the keys. The emergency release was the only thing that saved me. #reallifehorror #creepyencounter #ScaryTales

the-smoke-detector-camera.title: I found a hidden camera in the smoke detector of my rental
the-smoke-detector-camera.description: A tiny dark spot on the smoke detector of my rental, facing the bed, with a green blink at night. On day two I pulled the cover off and found a lens and a battery pack. The listing photos showed a different detector. I packed and left. #reallifehorror #creepyencounter #ScaryTales

the-fake-rideshare-driver.title: A fake rideshare driver knew my name at the airport
the-fake-rideshare-driver.description: My plane landed at midnight and a black sedan rolled up before my app said my driver was near. The man inside said my name - then told me to get in. One wrong word tipped me off. I walked back toward the terminal. #reallifehorror #truehorror #ScaryTales

the-airbnb-i-never-booked.title: Someone booked an Airbnb in my name using my photo
the-airbnb-i-never-booked.description: The Airbnb owner welcomed me by name. I never booked. Someone made the reservation with my photo and my address. I never found out who. Follow for more. #microhorror #creepypasta #ScaryTales

the-key-card-in-the-elevator.title: My key card was found in an elevator I wasn't in
the-key-card-in-the-elevator.description: The elevator opened at 3am holding my key card - the one in my pocket. My room was already unlocked. I never went back. What would you do? #horrortales #microhorror #ScaryTales

the-key-to-my-house.title: The man on my porch had a key to my house
the-key-to-my-house.description: I fell asleep with the deadbolt thrown. At 3am a man was on my porch, turning the key to my house over and over. I never opened the door. Would you? #microhorror #truescarystories #ScaryTales

the-man-behind-the-pillar.title: Halfway to my car, a man asked me if I was alone
the-man-behind-the-pillar.description: Halfway to my car, a man stepped out from behind a pillar and asked if I was alone. I locked my door just in time. Watch to the end. #creepyencounter #microhorror #ScaryTales

the-stranger-at-the-door.title: A stranger knocked asking for my father
the-stranger-at-the-door.description: A stranger knocked and asked if my father was home. I'd never seen him before. But I saw which room he'd been studying while he waited. #truehorror #microhorror #ScaryTales
